items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 79:1
items.html: The measure of coarseness is discerned only in the MAN that ascend from below upward. When the place of the coupling is in Bina, it brings out the level of Bina; when it is in the Einayim, it brings out the level of ZA; and when it rises to Galgalta, it brings out the level of Malchut. Therefore, since what is here is the discernment of Ibur [impregnation], the coupling is made in the place of the two names Ehyeh of Yods, which is the discernment of the Keter that is in the HGT of AA, standing in the place of the Garon [throat]. It therefore brings out the level of Malchut. (Page 939, Item 115).
